## Status taxonomy {#sec-register}

- **Model of record** — the authoritative model for a question; the only models the findings draw numbers from. (VG10, VG15; TD references VG11/VG12/VG13.)
- **Development step** — a model on the path to a model of record, presented in the lineage chapters and Appendix B for its methodological role; never sources a finding. (VG05, VG07, VG08, VG09; VG14.)
- **TD reference** — typically-developing models used for comparison. (VG11, VG12, VG13.)
- **Superseded precursor** — replaced by a later model and retained for completeness only. (VG03, VG04, VG06.)
